label: Matt 19:1
text: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

label: Matt 19:2
text: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

label: Matt 19:3
text: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

label: Matt 19:4
text: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

label: Matt 19:5
text: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?’

label: Matt 19:6
text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

label: Matt 19:7
text: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?”

label: Matt 19:8
text: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

label: Matt 19:9
text: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

variants.reading: Without 'and marries another': 'except for sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery'
variants.note: The fetched 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists παρεκτος λογου πορνειας ποιει αυτην μοιχευθηναι ('except on account of sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery') for Papyrus 25 (vid), B, 0233, 1, 4, 1582, l547, itff1, copbo, ethmss, slav, Origen and Cyril; the WEB wording 'and marries another, commits adultery' is the reading of the rest.

variants.reading: 'And anyone marrying a divorced woman commits adultery' (shorter closing clause)
variants.note: The article lists και ο απολελυμενην γαμων μοιχαται ('And anyone marrying a divorced woman commits adultery') for B, C*, E, F, G, H, K, M, N, O, U, W, Y, Z and a long series; the WEB reads 'and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery'.

label: Matt 19:10
text: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

label: Matt 19:11
text: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

label: Matt 19:12
text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

label: Matt 19:13
text: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

label: Matt 19:14
text: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

label: Matt 19:15
text: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

label: Matt 19:16
text: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

label: Matt 19:17
text: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

variants.reading: 'Why are you asking me about the good?' instead of 'Why do you call me good?'
variants.note: The fetched variants article lists τι με ερωτας περι του αγαθου for א, B, (D), L, Θ, f1, 1, 22, 700 and others, read also by Marcion and Clement; the WEB's 'Why do you call me good?' (τι με λεγεις αγαθον) is the reading of C, E, F, G, H, K, M, S, U, W, Y and the majority.

label: Matt 19:18
text: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

variants.reading: 'You shall not commit adultery. You shall not steal' omitted
variants.note: The fetched article lists ου μοιχευσεις ου κλεψεις ('you will not commit adultery, you will not steal') as 'omitted by א*' - the original hand of Sinaiticus, restored by the corrector; the WEB includes both commandments.

label: Matt 19:19
text: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

label: Matt 19:20
text: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

label: Matt 19:21
text: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

label: Matt 19:22
text: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

label: Matt 19:23
text: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

label: Matt 19:24
text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

variants.note: The fetched article lists καμιλον ('cable') in minuscules 174, 579, 1424 and lectionaries 211, 524, 673, 858, 859, 866, 1086 - none of this graph's manuscript nodes; Cyril of Alexandria suggested a Greek scribal error, and the same article states 'the evidence does not support this hypothesis'.
For 'needle's eye' the article lists τρυπηματος ('borehole') - W, אc, D, E, F, G, L, S, X, Y, Z and the majority - against τρηματος ('hole') in א* and B, which the WEB follows.

label: Matt 19:25
text: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

label: Matt 19:26
text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

label: Matt 19:27
text: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”

label: Matt 19:28
text: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

label: Matt 19:29
text: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

variants.note: The fetched article lists εκατονταπλασιονα ('hundredfold') for the great majority but πολλαπλασιονα ('manifold') for B, L, 579, 1010, syrpal, copsa, mae-1, ethms, the Diatessaron, Origen and Cyril; the WEB reads 'one hundred times'.
The article lists πατερα η μητερα ('father or mother') for B, 2148, ita,n, syrpal and Clement, against the WEB's 'father, or mother, or wife'.

label: Matt 19:30
text: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

label: Jesus goes to the region beyond the Jordan
statement: Jesus left Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan (Perea).

label: Great multitudes followed and he healed them there
statement: Great multitudes followed Jesus in the region beyond the Jordan, and he healed them there.

label: Pharisees test Jesus with the divorce question
statement: Pharisees came, testing Jesus, asking whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any cause.

label: Divorce 'for any cause' was a disputed question
statement: Whether a man may divorce his wife for any cause was a live, disputed question between the Houses of Shammai and Hillel.

label: Genesis 1:27 quoted for marriage
statement: Jesus answered from Genesis 1:27: he who made them from the beginning made them male and female.

label: Genesis 2:24 quoted: one flesh
statement: Jesus cited Genesis 2:24: a man leaves father and mother, is joined to his wife, and the two become one flesh.

label: The bill of divorce (get)
statement: Divorce was carried out by giving the wife a written bill of divorce, which Moses commanded.

label: Divorce and remarriage as adultery
statement: Whoever divorces his wife except for sexual immorality and marries another commits adultery; so does he who marries her when she is divorced.

label: Three kinds of eunuchs
statement: Jesus names eunuchs born so from the womb, eunuchs made so by men, and eunuchs who made themselves so for the kingdom of heaven.

label: Children brought for laying on of hands
statement: Little children were brought to Jesus so that he might lay his hands on them and pray, and the disciples rebuked the bringers.

label: The rich man asks about eternal life
statement: A man came and asked Jesus what good thing he should do to have eternal life, and went away sad for he had great possessions.

label: The commandments listed
statement: Jesus lists commandments: not murder, not adultery, not steal, not false witness, honor father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.

label: Sell, give to the poor, treasure in heaven
statement: Jesus tells the man to sell what he has, give to the poor, and so have treasure in heaven, and to come and follow him.

label: A camel through a needle's eye
statement: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.

label: Twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes
statement: In the regeneration the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, and his followers will sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

label: A hundredfold for leaving houses and lands
statement: Everyone who leaves houses, brothers, sisters, father, mother, wife, children or lands for Jesus's sake will receive a hundred times and inherit eternal life.

label: The first will be last
statement: Many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
